name: Testimonials
summary: The AhaSlides marketing site testimonial sections, in the layouts of the Untitled UI testimonial sections the marketing team picked (layout only; no Untitled UI photo or asset): Simple centred (3), Simple left aligned, Split image (3), Card, Card split image, Case study cards, Glassmorphic cards (3), Social cards (3) and Abstract image, plus Vivid Pink and pale pink copies of the brand layouts. Every placeholder is a real image file; the quote, rating, avatar, name and role styles are the DS Testimonial card. Framework-free and bound to the shared --aha-* tokens.
highlights: Seventeen layouts, each with its own labelled preview and paste-and-run snippet, plus Vivid Pink and pale pink copies of the nine brand layouts the Untitled UI set marks as brand

Every placeholder (customer photos, avatars, split photo, collage, case study covers, post pictures) is an pointing at a real image file with alt text, never a drawn box or initials; the files and their sources are listed in marketing/images/testimonials/manifest.json
Quote, system-star rating, 44px avatar, name and role styles are the Testimonial card of the Cards page; the large quote uses the marketing type scale and the radius is the marketing radius
Vivid Pink and pale pink surfaces and Darker Pink Splash hooks are the Hero banner ones (modifiers --pink and --pale)

Carousel layouts are a native scroll-snap track with the DS secondary icon-only button for arrows and plain buttons for dots; no autoplay, the track is focusable and scrolls with the arrow keys, and the small script only moves the track
Social cards use the X and LinkedIn marks from the Logo library by file name; company logos come from the Logos section data (marketing/data/logos-cms.json) in greyscale
Glassmorphic cards sit on the Vivid Pink surface with a frosted panel (backdrop-filter blur over the photo) and fall back to a solid panel where backdrop blur is not supported
Each section is a container-query block stepping down at 991, 767 and 479px
